focus.title: 本周全球经贸主线：出口管制联盟化与关税工具化并行，中国企业合规承压
focus.summary: 本周国际经贸领域呈现两条主线：一是美国与盟友在半导体、人工智能算力等领域强化出口管制协同，推动“小院高墙”向联盟化、机制化演进；二是关税工具被更频繁地用于产业政策与贸易谈判，涉及新能源、关键矿产等链条。欧盟亦推进关键原材料与供应链韧性审查。整体看，管制与关税叠加使跨境交易的不确定性上升，中国企业面临更复杂的合规审查与供应链重构压力，需前置评估交易对手、物项用途与转运风险。
focus.source: 来源：美国商务部、欧盟委员会及主要财经媒体 · 本周
focus.title_en: Weekly Global Trade Focus: Export Controls Turn Alliance-Based While Tariffs Become Policy Tools
focus.summary_en: This week international trade was shaped by two trends: the United States and its allies strengthened coordination on export controls covering semiconductors and AI computing power, moving the “small yard, high fence” approach toward alliance-based and institutionalized mechanisms; meanwhile, tariffs were used more frequently as instruments of industrial policy and trade negotiation, affecting new energy and critical minerals supply chains. The EU also advanced reviews on critical raw materials and supply chain resilience. Combined, controls and tariffs are heightening uncertainty in cross-border transactions, exposing Chinese companies to more complex compliance screening and supply chain restructuring pressure, requiring upfront assessment of counterparties, end uses and transshipment risks.
focus.source_en: Source: U.S. Department of Commerce, European Commission and major financial media · this week

case.title: 本周案例观察：跨境仲裁中“涉外因素”认定与临时措施跨境协助的启示
case.summary: 本周值得关注的是一起涉及中国企业与境外交易对手的跨境仲裁程序争议，焦点在于仲裁条款效力、涉外因素认定以及临时措施在境外的承认与协助。相关司法实践再次表明，法院对涉外因素的审查趋于实质化，仲裁条款的准据法与仲裁地约定需清晰无误。启示在于：出海企业应在合同中明确仲裁机构、仲裁地、语言与准据法，避免“或裁或审”模糊条款；在申请保全或临时措施时，提前评估资产所在地法院的协助路径与时间成本，以保障裁决的可执行性。
case.source: 来源：中国法院涉外仲裁司法审查实践 · 本周
case.title_en: Weekly Case Insight: Determining Foreign-Related Elements and Cross-Border Interim Relief in Arbitration
case.summary_en: This week’s notable case concerns a procedural dispute in cross-border arbitration involving a Chinese company and an offshore counterparty, focusing on the validity of the arbitration clause, the finding of foreign-related elements, and the recognition and assistance of interim measures abroad. The judicial practice again shows that courts scrutinize foreign-related elements substantively, and that the governing law of the arbitration clause and the seat of arbitration must be clearly stipulated. The takeaway for outbound companies is to specify the arbitral institution, seat, language and governing law, avoiding ambiguous “arbitration or litigation” clauses; when seeking preservation or interim measures, assess in advance the assistance pathways and time costs in the jurisdiction where assets are located to safeguard enforceability.
case.source_en: Source: Chinese judicial review practice on foreign-related arbitration · this week

policy.title: 本周政策综述：大湾区跨境贸易便利化与涉外法律服务开放举措持续推进
policy.summary: 本周中国涉外与跨境政策延续“便利化+法治化”导向。粤港澳大湾区在跨境数据流动、通关便利、跨境金融等方面继续推进试点，涉外法律服务领域进一步放宽联营所与港澳律师执业便利。同时，相关部门就出口管制合规、反外国制裁应对等发布指引性信息，强调企业建立内部合规体系。整体看，政策在扩大开放与风险防控之间寻求平衡，出海企业应关注大湾区跨境数据与资金流动的试点红利，同时完善出口管制与制裁合规内控，将政策机遇转化为合规竞争力。
policy.source: 来源：粤港澳大湾区相关主管部门及司法行政机关 · 本周
policy.title_en: Weekly Policy Roundup: Greater Bay Area Cross-Border Trade Facilitation and Opening of Foreign-Related Legal Services
policy.summary_en: This week China’s foreign-related and cross-border policies continued the “facilitation plus rule of law” orientation. The Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area advanced pilots in cross-border data flows, customs clearance facilitation and cross-border finance, while foreign-related legal services saw further relaxation of joint venture law firm arrangements and practice convenience for Hong Kong and Macao lawyers. Meanwhile, relevant authorities issued guidance on export control compliance and countering foreign sanctions, emphasizing internal compliance systems. Overall, policies seek a balance between opening up and risk prevention; outbound companies should capture pilot dividends in cross-border data and capital flows in the Greater Bay Area while improving export control and sanctions compliance controls, turning policy opportunities into compliance competitiveness.
policy.source_en: Source: Competent authorities and judicial administrative organs in the Greater Bay Area · this week

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师周度研判：管制与关税叠加下，出海企业应以合规前置与供应链韧性破局
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师周度研判：本周趋势表明，出口管制联盟化与关税工具化将长期并存，企业不能再将合规视为事后补救。建议出海企业：一是建立物项分类与交易对手筛查的常态化机制，重点审查最终用途与转运风险；二是在合同中嵌入管制变化、关税调整的重新谈判与退出条款；三是利用大湾区跨境数据与资金试点优化架构，但须确保数据出境合规；四是提前布局替代供应链与多币种结算。下周重点关注：美欧涉华管制清单更新、关税复审进展及大湾区跨境数据细则落地。
analysis.source: 来源：秦林蒿律师 · 本周研判
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's Weekly View: Under Overlapping Controls and Tariffs, Outbound Firms Should Break Through with Upfront Compliance and Supply Chain Resilience
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's weekly view: This week’s trends show that alliance-based export controls and tariff instrumentalization will coexist for the long term; compliance can no longer be treated as after-the-fact remediation. Outbound companies are advised to: first, establish routine mechanisms for item classification and counterparty screening, focusing on end-use and transshipment risks; second, embed renegotiation and exit clauses in contracts to address control changes and tariff adjustments; third, use Greater Bay Area pilots on cross-border data and capital to optimize structures while ensuring data export compliance; fourth, plan alternative supply chains and multi-currency settlement in advance. Next week, watch: updates to U.S. and EU China-related control lists, tariff review progress, and implementation details of Greater Bay Area cross-border data rules.
analysis.source_en: Source: Attorney Qin Linhao · weekly view
